meta.description: HPE Private Cloud AI (PCAI) system configurations. G2 = current (HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9, 02-Mar-2026); G1 = legacy (removed in V9, last listed in V7, 02-Sep-2025). GPUs per worker node, MIG partition table and NVLink domains come from the HPE AI Essentials 2026.07.1 docs in this repository.

sources.quickspecs_v9: https://www.hpe.com/psnow/doc/a50009216enw (HPE Private Cloud AI QuickSpecs, Version 9, 02-March-2026: 'HPE Private Cloud AI Family' p4, 'Expansion Racks' p5, T-shirt sizes p7)
sources.quickspecs_v7: https://www.hpe.com/psnow/doc/a50009216enw (Version 7, 02-September-2025: 'HPE Private Cloud AI G1 Family' p3, 'G2 Family' p4, T-shirt sizes p7)

meta.verify_on_site: kubectl get nodes -L nvidia.com/gpu.product -L nvidia.com/gpu.count -L hpe.com.nvidia/gpu.size ; lspci -nn | grep -i nvidia (gives [10de:<device>] = gpu_device <device>:10de)

configurations.name: PCAI Developer System (G2) - RTX PRO 6000
configurations.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute Gen12 worker node, 2x Intel Xeon 32-core
configurations.notes: Single worker node. The AIE MIG table writes the large slice as '2g48gb' (typo for 2g.48gb); there is no medium MIG size for this GPU. Data Lakehouse Gateway and NVIDIA Blueprints are not supported on the Developer System.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p4 'HPE Private Cloud AI Family' (Developer: 1 control node, 1 worker node, 2x RTX Pro 6000, 22 TB) and p3 'Developer system featuring NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs'
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1829-1846 (MIG table row 'Developer System | RTX Pro 6000 | 2 | 2 - No MIG | 4 - 2g48gb | N/A | 8 - 1g.24gb')
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:55-67 (Developer System limits)

configurations.name: PCAI Small (G2) - RTX PRO 6000
configurations.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core
configurations.storage: 109 TB HPE GreenLake for File with Object Storage
configurations.expansion: 1x RTX expansion rack: 8 or 12 RTX PRO 6000 GPUs in total
configurations.nvlink: None (PCIe Gen5): multi-GPU tensor parallelism goes over PCIe
configurations.notes: 1 or 2 worker nodes with 4 GPUs each.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p4 (Small: 3 control nodes, 1 or 2 worker nodes, 4 or 8x RTX Pro 6000, 109 TB) and p7 (expanded: 8 or 12 RTX Pro 6000 GPUs via 1x expansion rack)
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1829-1849 (MIG table row 'Small | RTX Pro 6000 | 4 | 4 - No MIG | 8 - 2g.48gb | N/A | 16 - 1g.24gb')

configurations.name: PCAI Medium (G2) - H200 NVL
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core, 2 NUMA nodes
configurations.storage: 109 TB HPE GreenLake for File with Object Storage
configurations.expansion: 1x H200 expansion rack: 24 H200 NVL GPUs in total
configurations.notes: HPE lists the GPU as 'H200'; the AIE docs and the Kubernetes label (nvidia.com/gpu.product=NVIDIA-H200-NVL) identify it as the PCIe H200 NVL (gpu_device 233b:10de), not the SXM H200 (2335:10de) that many NIM profiles target. Keep tp<=2 inside one NVLink domain for best performance.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p4 (Medium: 3 control nodes, 2 worker nodes, 8x H200, 109 TB, air-gapped option) and p7 (24x H200 via 1x expansion rack)
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1850-1852 (MIG table row 'Medium | H200 NVL | 4 | 4 - No MIG | 8 - 3g.71gb | 12 - 2g.35gb | 28 - 1g.18gb')
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:3060-3075 ('the Medium configuration system has four (4) H200 NVL GPUs per worker node'; NVLink domains GPU 0-1 / GPU 2-3)

configurations.name: PCAI Large (G2) - H200 NVL
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core, 2 NUMA nodes
configurations.storage: 217 TB HPE GreenLake for File with Object Storage
configurations.expansion: Up to 3x H200 expansion racks: up to 64 GPUs in total
configurations.notes: Same H200 NVL (233b:10de) as Medium. Known issue in the AIE docs: with 56 x 1g.18gb instances per node GPU pods can stay Terminating; the documented mitigation is whole-GPU partitions.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p4 (Large: 3 control nodes, 2 worker nodes, 16x H200 or RTX Pro 6000, 217 TB) and p7 (up to 64x via 3x expansion racks)
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1853-1854 (MIG table row 'Large | H200 NVL | 8 | 8 - No MIG | 16 - 3g.71gb | 24 - 2g.35gb | 56 - 1g.18gb')
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:3060-3080 ('The Large configuration system and expansion racks have eight (8) H200 NVL GPUs per worker node'; NVLink domains GPU 0-3 / GPU 4-7)

configurations.name: PCAI Large (G2) - RTX PRO 6000
configurations.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core
configurations.storage: 217 TB HPE GreenLake for File with Object Storage
configurations.expansion: Up to 3x RTX expansion racks (16 GPUs each)
configurations.notes: New in QuickSpecs V9. 8 GPUs per worker node is derived from 16 GPUs on 2 worker nodes. This configuration is not in the AIE 2026.07.1 MIG table: the MIG slices are inferred from the RTX PRO 6000 Small/Developer rows.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p3 ('Large configuration featuring NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs'), p4 (Large: 2 worker nodes, 16x H200 or RTX Pro 6000) and p5 (RTX expansion rack: 16x RTX Pro 6000 for Large)
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1829-1849 (RTX Pro 6000 MIG slices 2g.48gb / 1g.24gb)

configurations.name: PCAI H200 Expansion Rack (G2)
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core
configurations.expansion: Attaches to a Medium (1 rack) or Large (up to 3 racks) system
configurations.notes: MIG partitions are not listed separately for expansion racks; they follow the Large H200 NVL worker node (same 8-GPU node).
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p5 'HPE Private Cloud AI Expansion Racks' (H200 expansion rack: 0 control nodes, 2 worker nodes, 16x H200 for Medium or Large, air-gapped option)
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:3060-3080 (expansion racks: eight H200 NVL GPUs per worker node, NVLink GPU 0-3 / 4-7)

configurations.name: PCAI RTX Expansion Rack for Small (G2)
configurations.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core
configurations.notes: 4 GPUs per worker node is derived from 8 GPUs on 2 worker nodes; MIG slices follow the Small RTX PRO 6000 row.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p5 'HPE Private Cloud AI Expansion Racks' (RTX expansion rack: 2 worker nodes, 8x RTX Pro 6000 (Small))

configurations.name: PCAI RTX Expansion Rack for Large (G2)
configurations.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 86-core
configurations.expansion: Attaches to a Large RTX system

sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p5 'HPE Private Cloud AI Expansion Racks' (RTX expansion rack: 2 worker nodes, 16x RTX Pro 6000 (Large))

configurations.name: PCAI Developer System (G1) - H100 NVL
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute Gen11 worker node, 2x Intel Xeon 32-core
configurations.notes: G1 configurations were removed from the QuickSpecs in V9 (March 2026) but installed systems remain supported; the AIE 2026.07.1 MIG table still lists this system.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V7 p3 'HPE Private Cloud AI G1 Family' (Developer: 1 worker node, 2x H100NVL, 32 TB) and p7
HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V9 p11 'Removed G1 Configurations'
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/03_Administration.md:1829-1842 (MIG table row 'Developer System | H100 NVL | 2 | 2 - No MIG | 4 - 3g.47gb | 6 - 2g.24gb | 14 - 1g.12gb')

configurations.name: PCAI Small (G1) - L40S
configurations.server_platform: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen11 worker nodes, 2x Intel Xeon 32-core
configurations.storage: 109 TB HPE GreenLake for File with Object Storage
configurations.notes: L40S does not support MIG. The AIE docs ask for 4 L40S GPUs (instead of the default 2) for llama-3.1-70b and llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1.5.
sources: HPE QuickSpecs a50009216enw V7 p3 'HPE Private Cloud AI G1 Family' (Small: 1 or 2 worker nodes, 4 or 8x L40S, 109 TB, 100 Gb NICs) and p7 (smart template 'PrivateCloudAI-Small-1Svr/4xL40S GPU')
Guides/PCAI_docs/PCAI_2026.07.1/09_Gen-AI.md:299-313 and 1541-1557 (L40S GPU counts for large models)
